articles.title: Everything we know about Europa Universalis 5

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
Paradox have announced grand strategy game Europa Universalis 5, following some teasers last week. It's the next big entry in the series of complex globe-spanning historical simulations, and having played a little as the hapless ruler of Korea in the 14th century, I can confirm that it is so far as chunky, complicated, and deep as usual. The changes in this sequel won't look wild or revolutionary to a dabbler, but seasoned tyrants might find a lot to pique their interest. Come see a trailer below.
 Read more
articles.title: The next grand strategy game from Paradox is Europa Universalis 5

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
We all know that Palworld developer Pocketpair are currently dealing with a lawsuit from Mario maker Nintendo. Specifically, it's over patent rights, rather than something like copyright infringement which everyone was expecting given the liberties that Palword takes with its Pal designs. In November it was confirmed what those patents are, partially relating to the fact you could throw out your Pals from a ball and they'd appear, similar to Pokemon Legends Arceus. That feature was patched out from Palworld though, and in a new post Pocketpair has confirmed that this is because of the ongoing lawsuit.
 
Read more
articles.title: Palworld's newest patch stops you from gliding with your Pals, and yes, it is because of Nintendo's lawsuit

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
3D platformer Paperklay has perhaps the least appealing protagonists I've seen in a game recently. I hate avian buddy duo "Chick & Nugget" and all their works, beginning with the ghastly 3am pun that appears to have spawned them.
Look at that ampersand, dangling in the middle like a chunk of gristle. What an absolute crime against typography. And chickens. And platform game levels made of paper and card - you'd never put an actual chicken nugget on dioramas like these, the grease would ruin it. I also mistrust Chick's beady black eyes, and I can't abide the fact that Nugget is wearing a fragment of eggshell for pants. That's like a human child using a placenta as a necktie! Argh!
  
Read more
articles.title: New platformer Paperklay is a little bit Banjo, a little bit LittleBigPlanet

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Earlier today there was a mighty eruption of Death Stranding 2: On The Beach previews, featuring commentary on the new game's themes and social relevance from erstwhile Metal Gear Solidifier and Kojima Productions boss Hideo Kojima. Themes and social relevance, eh! Kojima is one of the few bigwigs who will engage openly with such things, which is perhaps less praise of Kojima than a judgement upon the hesitant and anodyne way other blockbuster game creators discuss the impact of their work. 
In this case, Kojima has talked at some length about how Death Stranding 2 builds on and, at times, resists the first game's theme of connection, based on his experiences of the Covid pandemic and his dislike of the "metaverse" - that ageing umbrella term for a newly monetisable "web 3.0" fauxtopia of networked technologies, ranging from VR to cryptocurrency, which many large video game publishers have sought to normalise in their hunger for profit growth.
 Read more
articles.title: Death Stranding 2 is as much a rebuttal of Death Stranding's theme of connection as a sequel

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Doom: The Dark Ages releases next week, and with it the realisation that Doom Guy has come a long way since the murder of his beloved rabbit Daisy at the hands of hell. While FPS Pigface is naturally a genre descendant of Doom, I cannot say for certain if the evil rabbit that commands you to go do sledgehammer murder in its Itch.io combat demo is a descendant of Daisy. Either way, it's an ominous critter. "You know what you did to deserve this," says the rabbit. A free sledgehammer? Thanks rabbit! I knew I was good this week.
Read more
articles.title: A rabbit would like you to kill people in grimy, repellent FPS Pigface

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
"Attacking is the most consistent element of Elden Ring Nightreign’s gameplay," says director Junya Ishizaki in a new PlayStation blog, explaining the choice to have players revive each other by hitting wounded mates with swords - a famously crucial tenet of the hippocratic oath. "We tested to see if it would work for resuscitation, and we discovered a wide variety of tactics depending on range, frequency, and probability, so we formally implemented it. We also found it quite amusing (laughs)."
Read more
articles.title: Elden Ring: Nightreign has a solution to stale strategies, says director

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Today, 8th May, is a day of compound darkness, for it sees the release of (at least) two games with "midnight" in the title: Midnight Special from Scared Stupid Inc, and The Midnight Walk from Moonhood. A coincidence? Absolutely not. This is clearly an occult configuration of daunting power. It's also an opportunity to briefly compare two video game aesthetics, each comparably dense, tasty and insidious.
 
Read more
articles.title: A choice of two Midnights

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
Necromancy is a dark art, forbidden by the mages guild in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered. At least, that's what characters in the open world RPG will tell you, before selling you a spell that lets you raise skellingtons from the dirt. You can be promoted to the head of the Mages Guild, in spite of all those corpses you keep bringing back to life. Necromancy banned? Seems like no one cares.
Well, one modder has fixed that. The mod, simply titled "Necromancy Is Actually Banned", will see you expelled from the Mages Guild if you perform any necrotic abracadabras in sight of a fellow member. You can also get fined by the guards.
Read more
articles.title: Raising the dead in Oblivion Remastered is "actually illegal" now thanks to this necromancy mod

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
Humble Choice has unveiled its May 2025 bundle, offering subscribers a collection of eight notable PC titles along with a complimentary month of IGN Plus. For $11.99 / £8.99 per month, the service continues its value-driven approach, touting a total value of over $280.
 Read more
articles.title: May's Humble Choice line up includes The Thaumaturge, Amnesia: The Bunker, and Evil West

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
This is just a quick write-up, because it's outside office hours, but... Mobius Digital, creators of wondrous virtual orrery and gravitational stageplay Outer Wilds, are making a new game.
 Read more
articles.title: The Outer Wilds developers are making a new game

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
There's a new king of RTX 5080 laptop deals, and it's this HP Omen Max 16 configuration. At $2,609.99 shipped with promo code PC10DEAL, it undercuts the competition by hundreds of dollars without compromising on power.
 Read more
articles.title: Best RTX 5080 laptop deal: HP Omen Max 16 is down to just $2610 today

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Sony have announced a new PlayStation studio made up of former developers of Destiny, Halo, League Of Legends, Fortnite, and Roblox, plus a few industry newcomers. Called teamLFG - where "LFG" stands for Looking For Group, not the other, naughty phrase you're thinking of - they're based in Bellevue, Washington, and are dedicated to "exceptional action-based gameplay, moment-to-moment game feel, and richly social virtual worlds". Uuuuuurrrgh. Their first project is a "comedic" and "lighthearted" team-based action game set in a new science-fantasy universe.
The PlayStation blogpost announcing all this is a wearying paean to an idea of the live service game that dates back to the original Destiny in 2014. It's written in the style of a cyborg that is trying to remember how to love. There is, however, a spark of eccentricity at the end that makes the labour of being preached to about engagement processes worthwhile: the team claim to be inspired by "frog-type games". What is a frog-type game? A Frogger homage? A real estate sim about Finishing Rooms Over Garages? Did they just misspell "frag"? The mind froggles.
 Read more
articles.title: Despair at prospect of new PlayStation live service game lifted by mysterious mention of frogs

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Cough! Splutter! Sneeze! Excuse me, it's mighty dusty in here all of a sudden. Exceedingly dirty alleged leaked images of both the Asus ROG Ally 2 and what could be Microsoft's rumoured "Project Kennan" gaming handheld have burst forth from the tissues of the internet in a shower of dead skin particles and grime.
 Read more
articles.title: Here are some leaked images of an Xbox-branded handheld and the Asus ROG Ally 2

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
The second trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6 came out yesterday. The open world crime 'em up looks as flashy and expensive as you might expect from a Rockstar game, and we now know more about the game's story, particularly the two sexy reprobates you'll be playing as in the streets of Vice City and the swampy countryside beyond. They are horny, jacked, thicc, and pretty as a picture of your prettiest purple petticoat. They are also, so far, extremely boring. 
Read more
articles.title: The anti-heroes of Grand Theft Auto 6 look sexy and dull

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
Walmart's dropped the price of this INIU 25000mAh 65W power bank to just $32.99, down from $59.99 when you sign in and clip the on-page coupon.
 Read more
articles.title: Walmart just dropped this 65W power bank to a crazy good $33, and it's perfect for Steam Deck

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
Fanatical's new Bethesda bundle deal is a rare case where you get full control — pick the games you actually want, from Fallout: New Vegas and Oblivion to Dishonored and The Evil Within 2.
 Read more
articles.title: Build your own Bethesda PC games bundle for just $15 and score five classic games

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Sponge away the dross and ephemera of my life and you're left with a series of moments in which I wonder: is now the right time to get into Legend of Heroes? I've been planning to play Nihon Falcom's 17-part RPG series ever since a respected peer gently suggested that my enthusiasm for Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest marked me out as a Basic Bitch, and that if I ever want to experience a real role-playing game, I should give LoH a go.
 
Read more
articles.title: The supposed secret best Japanese RPG gets a full remake in September

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
One of the programmers behind the very first Grand Theft Auto has praised Rockstar for delaying GTA 6's initial release to May next year, observing (not in so many words) that the developers could have rushed out an early release consisting of a city's worth of T-posing NPCs and whitebox freeways, and people would still have paid top dollar for the game. 

 
Read more
articles.title: GTA 6's animations have improved, says original GTA programmer: "things are moving much better"

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Polar Star is, basically, rock paper pistol, but with a few dab-handed puzzle twists that make it instantly compelling.  You're a saloon dwelling varmint sat at a table with nothing but your six shooter and a glass of whiskey for company, and you're accosted by a chain of ne'er-do-wells. Perhaps there's a bounty on your head. Perhaps it's their whiskey you're drinking. It's not clear, but it seems nefarious. You know what ne'er-do-wells are like.
Read more
articles.title: Someone made a Rock Paper Shotgun game. Well, pistol anyway

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Last month, Blizzard announced the first of their planned collaboration events/themed cosmetic greed-jamborees for action RPG Diablo 4. Kicking things off is Berserk - Kentaro Miura's dark fantasy manga about a large man swinging a large sword at demons, full of panels that are very good at conveying thrilling duels with a bunch of slash marks and captions that say 'snick' a lot. I'm no superfan, but I do own a few books, and the original anime is one of my favourites - even if its brilliant theme song lied to me re: having zero problems in life as long as I'm wearing my glasses.
Read more
articles.title: You could buy Berserk's entire Golden Age arc in hardback for the price of Diablo 4's crossover cosmetics

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Last month, FromSoftware announced that Elden Ring would be coming to the Nintendo Switch 2, which is wonderful for that plumber guy, but mostly meant piss all for us PC people. The thing is, this version of the game actually comes with some new stuff, and I like new stuff, and publisher Bandai Namco only vaguely said all the new bits would be coming to "other platforms". But! I bring good news, as yes, the Switch 2 Tarnished Edition extras are coming to PC as part of a Tarnished Pack DLC.

 
Read more
articles.title: Those Nintendo Switch 2 Elden Ring extras are coming to PC as well, just don't get too excited about them

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Alright, look, I get it. There's a lot of farming sims already. There's even the odd anime inspired farming sim here and there. But Tales of Seikyu, which fits into that second camp, is different, I promise, because it has dating - and I think you can date an anthropomorphic otter man. I'm not talking queer slang here to be clear, though the character does kind of fit that meaning too. I'm talking about a man that looks like an otter, who walks around on two legs.

 
Read more
articles.title: Yokai farming sim Tales of Seikyu gets an early access release date, may or may not let you date a handsome otter man

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
While Bungie is obviously quite busy presumably stressing over lukewarm responses to its next game Marathon, they're still working on a bunch of Destiny 2 stuff. The studio revealed a plethora of expansions today, all of which are building up a new "multi-year saga" called the Fate Saga. We'll get to it in a moment, but one of these expansions might raise an eyebrow, as it is quite literally a Star Wars crossover, but is also described by narrative designer Alison Luhrs as one that will push the Fate Saga "forward in important ways and introduce characters that we're going to spend time with for years to come."

 
Read more
articles.title: Turns out Bungie's plan to save Destiny 2 is literal Star Wars and two expansions a year

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
I think this Alienware AW3225QF is one of the most impressive displays I've seen hit the $900 mark in a long time.
 Read more
articles.title: Alienware's 32-inch 4K QD-OLED monitor is down to $899, and I’d pick it over any ultrawide right now

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
I'm a bit of a sucker for weird genre combos. With the amount of games getting released every single day that often combine the same kinds of genres, you start to get hungry for mashups that make you go, "hang on, would that even work?" So when I saw Drop Duchy release yesterday, which mixes Tetris, land-grabbing strategy, deckbuilding and roguelite gameplay, I asked that exact question. Turns out the answer is yes!

 
Read more
articles.title: I didn't think it was possible to make a Tetris-like strategy game, and yet Drop Duchy's launch yesterday has proven me wrong

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Stellaris is one of those forever games where occasionally I'll see that it's released something new and think "dang, that old dog is still truckin' along?" It seems to be that time of year again, as both a big update for the game as well as a new expansion dropped yesterday. Paradox previously described this as a "phoenix update" to try and sort out a bunch of the game's long-running issues, as well as make some tweaks to help bring in new players.

 
Read more
articles.title: Stellaris' new DLC BioGenesis lets you breed an existentially terrifying but cool as hell planet-sized monster, is out now

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
Rockstar have released a second trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6. It's one of those cinematic clip shows of scenes from the game, setting up the story and relationship between dual protagonists Jason and Lucia. It's horny and boring at the same time. Nope, there's still no word on a PC release, sorry. 
 Read more
articles.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 gets a second trailer but there's still no date for a PC version

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
I think this Alienware Aurora ACT1250 deal is exactly what I'd recommend to anyone who wants a top-end desktop without falling into the rabbit hole of part-picking and compatibility headaches.
 Read more
articles.title: Alienware has best RTX 5080 prebuilt deal out there, here's how to secure a huge discount

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
What in the name of jumping jellybeans is happening to The Maw? Our grizzled regular column summarising all the latest game news is going through some sort of midlife crisis and doesn't know what it wants to be. I can hear it grinding its molars, squelching its many news bladders, and unfurling its long, insipid tendrils. The usual Mawkeeper, Edwin, is away today, so it's up to me to soothe the beast and tell you all the new games being released on PC this week, as well as a hint for some anticipated strategy game news from Paradox Interactive.
Read more
articles.title: Here's what's happening in PC games this week

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Nihil perpetuum, pauca diuturna sunt. Nic netrvá věčně. Ani tento vesmír, ani jeden život, ani jedna říše. Přesvědčily se o tom mnohé národy. A také mnohé softwarové projekty. Kolik života má před sebou ten největší, jaký lidstvo stvořilo?
articles.title: Kdy skončí éra Linuxu?

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Martin Beran)
articles.description: Máme dokončený hardware počítače MB5016 a nyní si ukážeme, jak ho můžeme začít programovat. K tomu účelu si vytvoříme dva základní vývojové nástroje – debugger a assembler.
articles.title: Navrhujeme a vyrábíme vlastní CPU: vývojové nástroje

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Ukážeme si natrénování a validaci běžné neuronové sítě takovým způsobem, aby dokázala rozeznávat zašuměné a posunuté obrazy číslic. Bude se jednat o základ, který nám umožní přechod ke konvolučním neuronovým sítím.
articles.title: PyTorch: problematika rozpoznávání a klasifikace obrázků (2. část)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Sluka)
articles.description: Pravidelná sonda do světa software. Podíváme se na nástroj pro monitorování různých aspektů systému, budeme vytvářet git commit zprávy s emojis a nakonec vyzkoušíme pomocníka pro měření latence při probouzení procesoru z nečinnosti.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (14. 5. 2025): monitorujte stav systému minimalisticky

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Kdo ovládá váš počítač? Jste to skutečně vy nebo je to někdo jiný, kdo pro vás napsal uzavřený software, který může dělat cokoliv. Nejen o svobodě a nezávislosti mluvil na své přednášce Richard Stallman.
articles.title: Potřebujeme svobodný software, abychom zůstali nezávislí, říká RMS

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Prozatím jsme se zaměřili na assembler. Proč se však více nepoužívaly překladače vyšších programovacích jazyků? Dnes se na tuto otázku pokusíme částečně odpovědět otestováním několika dobových překladačů jazyka C.
articles.title: Překladače na platformě IBM PC: od assembleru k C

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: CESNET CERTS)
articles.description: V najnovších Postrehoch sa pozrieme na to, ako hackeri hackli hackerov, ďalej na varovania pred útokmi na energetiku USA, viacero aktualizácií softvéru, zásah proti DDoS službám a na cvičenie Locked Shields.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: tvrdá rana pre Lockbit a útoky na energetiku

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Linux Mint 22.2 bude mít kódové označení „Zara“ a LMDE 7 se bude jmenovat „Gigi“. Rozjela se kampaň nazvaná „Konec desítek“, která vyzývá k přechodu na Linux. System76 osvěžuje linuxový notebook Serval WS novým hardwarem.
articles.title: Konec desítek jako šance pro Linux, System76 osvěžuje notebook Serval WS

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: OpenRazer 3.10.3 přidává podporu Razer Naga V2 Pro a Strider Chroma, nový přehrávač videa Showtime pro GNOME 49, Lavapipe přidává další vlastnosti pro VKD3D-Proton
articles.title: KDE beze spánku při přenosu souborů, Intel se záměrnou možností zpomalení PCIe pro Battlemage

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Podpora Block Write Streams pro NVMe Flexible Data Placement, vylepšení pro integrovaná grafická jádra v CPU Intel Haswell, až 2048 CPU jader pro čínský Loongson, aktualizace podpory Apple Silicon, Intel a Link-Off Between Frames.
articles.title: Jádro Linux 6.16 s prioritami úloh v AMDGPU či podporou dlouhých blokových zápisů u NVMe

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Projekt Tor oznámil nástroj oniux, který zajišťuje izolaci sítě Tor pomocí jmenných prostorů v Linuxu pro aplikace třetích stran. Oniux přesměruje jakýkoli linuxový program do vlastního síťového jmenného prostoru, aby jeho provoz mohl poslat přes Tor a ochránit jej tak před možnosti úniku dat.
articles.title: Oniux umožňuje poslat provoz z aplikací přes Tor díky izolaci v linuxovém jádře

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Lenka Bočincová)
articles.description: Už za necelý měsíc, 5. a 6. června, se na FIIT Bratislava uskuteční čtvrtý ročník KCD Czech & Slovak, dvoudenní komunitní akce zaměřené na Cloud Native technologie a CNCF komunitu. Tuto akci pořádá parta z cloud native meetupů v ČR a SR, která pro vás připravuje nabitý program plný přednášek, workshopů a networkingu.
articles.title: Program KCD Czech & Slovak je tu: dva dny plné technologií cloud native v Bratislavě

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Nextcloud poskytuje open-source platformu pro spolupráci nazvanou Nextcloud Hub, která zahrnuje funkce sdílení souborů a synchronizace. Společnost napsala na svém blogu příspěvek, ve kterém vysvětluje, že společnost Google zrušila kritické oprávnění aplikace Nextcloud Files pro Android, které jí umožňuje synchronizovat soubory s Nextcloud Hub.
articles.title: Nextcloud tvrdí, že Google zneužívá svého dominantního postavení

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Přibližně před rokem bylo oznámeno, že projekt TrueNAS už nadále nebude postaven na FreeBSD a jeho vývoj se zaměří už jen na Linux. Letos v únoru tak skončilo rozdělení na větve CORE (FreeBSD) a SCALE (Linux) a dále existuje už jen varianta TrueNAS Community Edition (CE) využívající pouze linuxový základ.
articles.title: Komunita FreeBSD chce pokračovat v TrueNAS CORE a zakládá projekt zVault

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Red Hat zřejmě v tichosti zpřístupnila RHEL 10 platícím zákazníkům, několik dní před jeho očekávaným oficiálním představením na Red Hat Summitu, který se uskuteční příští týden. V běžném seznamu vydání desítku nenajdete, ale po přepnutí do japonštiny se objeví. Stránka pak prozradí, že RHEL 10 vyšel 13. května 2025 a nese kódové jméno Coughlan.
articles.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 je už dostupný pro platící zákazníky

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Let's Encrypt nebude od roku 2026 zahrnovat do svých certifikátů rozšířené použití klíče (Extended Key Usage – EKU) s označením „TLS Client Authentication“. Většiny uživatelů, kteří používají Let's Encrypt k zabezpečení webových stránek, se to nedotkne a nebudou muset podnikat žádné kroky. Pokud však používáte certifikáty Let's Encrypt jako klientské certifikáty pro ověřování na serveru, může se vás tato změna týkat.
articles.title: Let's Encrypt ukončí v příštím roce podporu TLS certifikátů pro ověřování klientů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Vývojáři uvolnili novou verzi nástroje Grafana označenou číslem 12. Hlavní novinkou je posun ke konfiguraci v podobě kódu. Nyní lze dashboardy, upozornění a pravidla pro záznam plně spravovat prostřednictvím pracovních postupů zaměřených na kód. Grafanu je možné připojit přímo k úložišti na GitHubu a verzovat ji společně s kódem aplikace. Úpravy uživatelského rozhraní pak probíhají pomocí pull requestů, což zajišťuje plnou auditovatelnost a snadnější spolupráci.
articles.title: Grafana 12 přichází s konfigurací v podobě kódu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: SSD podporující PCI Express 5.0 jsou tu s námi už mnoho a mnoho měsíců. První modely byly jen o trochu rychlejší než nejrychlejší PCIe 4.0 SSD, později výkon rostl až do mezí blízkých limitu čtyř PCIe 5.0 linek, kterými typicky disponuje M.2 2280 slot. Ale to vše za cenu velmi vysoké spotřeby a nutnosti takové SSD velmi důkladně chladit – často byla dodávána s aktivními chladiči s maličkým ventilátorkem (a dávala tak vzpomenou éry základních desek z počátku století s jejich 7000rpm „komáry“).
articles.title: Kingston uvedl SSD Fury Renegade G5, éra PCIe 5.0 je definitivně tady

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Proxmox je moderní virtualizační platforma, která v mnoha případech může nahradit VMware. Je open-source, zdarma a je postaven na otevřených technologiích jako KVM, LXC, CEPH a dalších. Pokud potřebujete provozovat virtualizaci, Proxmox je pro vás ideální stack a na našem workshopu Proxmox se dozvíte, jak na něj.
articles.title: Proxmox: moderní virtualizační platforma schopná nahradit VMware (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Mozilla dokončila proces přechodu od vlastních Mercurial serverů (hg.mozilla.org) na GitHub. Jde o přenos oficiálního repozitáře na jiný systém a nijak se nedotýká systémů pro sledování chyb, continuous integration (CI) či jiné další prvky využívané při vývoji prohlížeče.
articles.title: Firefox už hostuje zdrojové kódy na GitHubu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Spectre je potvora mizerná, Intel ji vyhodí dveřmi a ona se vrátím oknem. Nebo komínem. A tak tu vedle Training Solo, která zase vrací na scénu Spectre v2, tu máme Branch Privilege Injection alias CVE-2024–45332, která pro změnu vrací na scénu problém jménem Spectre-BTI.
articles.title: Další zranitelnost CPU Intel se jmenuje Branch Privilege Injection, je typu Spectre-BTI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Šimerda)
articles.description: EurOpen to letos rozbalí trochu netypicky s tématem programovacích jazyků. Možná byste nečekali, že se tam objeví starší jazyky jako Cobol, Modula nebo APL, ale samotná konference probíhá docela dlouho, už od roku 1988.
articles.title: 57. konference EurOpen.cz proběhne od 25. do 28. května 2025

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Čerstvě odhalená metoda, jak prolomit opravy na Spectre v2, už má nejen záplaty přímo v linuxovém jádru, ale též i aktualizaci mikrokódu CPU pro postižené procesory společnosti Intel. Jde o verzi Intel Microcode 20250512, která je jako obvykle k dispozici na GitHubu Intelu a která už je distribuována linuxovými systémy do světa.
articles.title: Intel vydal aktualizaci mikrokódu CPU na zranitelnost Training Solo

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: PeoplePath)
articles.description: Společnost PeoplePath pořádá v Plzni workshopy na různá IT témata. Tentokrát bylo téma WebAssembly - Začátek konce éry JavaScriptu? a byl pořízen videozáznam.
articles.title: Video z workshopu WebAssembly - Začátek konce éry JavaScriptu?

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Bezpečnostní tým SUSE zveřejnil článek s podrobnostmi o několika bezpečnostních problémech, které odhalil v programu GNU Screen. Patří mezi ně zneužití lokálního roota, pokud je Screen nainstalován jako setuid-root, jak je tomu v některých linuxových distribucích a BSD.
articles.title: Několik bezpečnostních problémů v terminálovém multiplexeru Screen

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Při uvedení grafických karet Battlemage bylo Intelu vyčítáno mnohé. Že neuvádí hi-end model. Že uvádí karty se zpožděním X měsíců (za X se dosazovaly různé hodnoty). Že výkonově nepředvedl, co sliboval. Všechny tyto věci byly pravdou. Karty přišly později, než Intel původně sliboval, hi-end se nedostavil a výkon nakonec nebyl takový, jaký Intel původně sliboval. Ale od začátku jsme mnozí neustále poukazovali na historickou zkušenost s Intelem, že minimálně poslední položka se bude měnit. Phoronix nyní v novém testu konstatuje, že jak původní generace Alchemist, reprezentovaná modelem Arc A770, tak oba existující modely Battlemage, dostaly za posledního půl roku solidní injekci výkonu navíc.
articles.title: Intel Arc B570 a B580 Battlemage na Linuxu pět měsíců od uvedení: +10 % výkonu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Výzkumníci ve VUSec (na Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam) objevili novou zranitelnost, kterou jsou postiženy CPU architektury Intelu a ARMu. Dostala název Training Solo a souvisí se Spectre v2. Detailní popis na webu VUSec v PDF.
articles.title: Training Solo: nová zranitelnost postihuje ARM a Intel

articles.author: Adam Newell
articles.description:
There is over three weeks to go until the Nintendo Switch 2 launches worldwide despite the ongoing worries regarding US tariff changes and other worldwide events hindering supply, though I am happy to confirm that I was able to grab not one, but two pre-orders of the Mario Kart World version of the console ahead of release.


Why two? Protection in case one gets cancelled. We have all been there before on a new console release where a company takes on too many pre-orders and ends up cancelling one, leaving you without a system at all on launch or having to scrounge each page, refreshing every minutes in hopes that pre-orders randomly appear (they don't, but we pray they do.) I'll likely send a console pack or give the second console to a family member for free if I end up getting both. No way am I joining the scalper hoard. No sir.




Thankfully, with three weeks to go, some sites are starting to add more pre-orders, but that does beg the question: Were you able to secure your own pre-orders? And if so, what games do you plan to get at launch? (There is a lot after all, I don't know how I'm going to find time for both Mario Kart and the new DELTARUNE chapters, to name a few.)


And if you weren't able to secure a pre-order, how come? Were you unlucky? Are you giving the system a miss at launch on purpose to wait for another version of the console down the line, or waiting for the holiday season? I'm genuinely curious what everyone could secure and would love to hear about your experiences in the comments below.


Either way. If you did get the console, I hope to see you all in Mario Kart World for the next month, where I will be playing nothing but the new knockout mode, sweating on Rosalina, trying to climb whatever arbitrary ranked or points system the game has.


See you there!

The post Did you get your Switch 2 pre-order, Destructoid? appeared first on Destructoid.
articles.title: Did you get your Switch 2 pre-order, Destructoid?

President Trump's strategy to "save" the "dying" movie industry in the United States amounts to a 100% tariff on "any and all" movies produced in "foreign lands." Trump appears to be taking aim at generous incentives offered by the UK, among others. In a response, think tank ITIF suggests an alternative; urge Congress to pass site-blocking legislation and compel countries to enforce copyright protection as part of their tariff negotiations.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Trump Told to Back Pirate Site Blocking Law Instead of 100% Movie Tariffs

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The legal dispute between Apple and the iOS Musi app has escalated, with Apple seeking sanctions over allegedly false claims made by the developer after its App Store removal. Apple contests Musi's assertion of a "backchannel" scheme, citing evidence gathered during discovery. Underscoring its claims of dishonesty, Apple details how Musi allegedly regained App Store access in 2020 by fraudulently impersonating a UMG executive.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Musi Faked UMG Email to Stay on App Store, Apple Claims in Sanctions Motion

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Users of pirate IPTV services in Sweden are actively trying to circumvent new ISP blockades ordered by Stockholm's Patent and Market Court. The court sided with rightsholders Viaplay, TV4, and Discovery, requiring Telenor and other ISPs to block subscriber access to pirate IPTV providers. This triggered a cat and mouse game that will likely intensify the call for broader blocking measures. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Swedish IPTV Crackdown Tested as Users Seek Workarounds

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
For almost three months, Spain's LaLiga and local ISPs have been blocking IP addresses en masse to prevent piracy, fully aware that thousands of innocent internet users are repeatedly blocked at the same time. In the wake of a European Union Intellectual Property Office visit to Madrid, and a meeting last week at EUIPO in Alicante, Twitch IP addresses were among dozens more blocked on Saturday. Today, LaLiga doubled its blocking efforts - literally.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Twitch Blocked For Piracy as LaLiga & ISPs Prioritize Football Over Everything

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In the escalating war against online book piracy, Dutch takedown outfit Link-Busters continues to shatter records. In less than a year, the company reported over two billion pirate URLs to Google search, reaching a milestone of three billion reported URLs overall. While the volume is impressive, it also signals that the piracy problem is far from being tackled, for now.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Link-Busters Reports its Three Billionth ‘Pirate’ URL to Google Search

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Early April, Belgian media reported new pirate IPTV blocking under a new court obtained by DAZN and 12th Player. Described as "the first of its kind," DNS providers reportedly faced fines of €100,000 per day for non-compliance. Soon after, OpenDNS left Belgium, a replay of its earlier departures from both France and Portugal. Hailed as a “real step forward” against piracy but no mention of a third loss to DNS, the order also contains an apparent secret sauce.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DAZN’s New Pirate IPTV Blocking Order and its ‘Confidential’ Secret Sauce

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Office of the United States Trade Representative has released its annual Special 301 Report, calling out countries that fall short on anti-piracy enforcement and other forms of intellectual property protection. Vietnam is once again one of the key targets and still perceived as a piracy haven, despite the historic takedown of the Fmovies piracy ring last summer.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: US: Vietnam Remains a “Piracy Haven” Despite Fmovies Crackdown

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
The Association of Electronic Communications Operators has provided a very gloomy assessment of progress in the fight against piracy in Portugal. While that may not sound especially unusual, this summer will mark 10 years since the launch of an industry-led, voluntary site-blocking regime, which reportedly reduced visits to pirate sites by 60%+ in a matter of months. Apritel now says that swift financial sanctions are required to being persistent pirate consumers back into line.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Blocks Ineffective? Telcos Call For Sanctions Against Portuguese Users

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Spotify has come a long way since it openly appealed to music pirates in its early days. This week, the streaming giant targeted "SpotifyDL," a browser extension enabling users to download tracks, playlists and albums, by bypassing its protections. Following a DMCA notice filed with GitHub, Spotify successfully forced the developer to strip the tool's core functionality.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Spotify Dismantles ‘SpotifyDL’ Track Download Extension via DMCA Notice

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (sev)
articles.description:
This is yet another exciting year for the ScummVM project as we have five GSoC contributors joining the project this summer.
Ellen Moon will be continuing work on adding Text-to-Speech to more engines. This will increase accessibility for those games that were missing voice-overs. This task will be presented on Ellen's GSoC blog.
Aun Noman (known as Prime) will, at the same time, be adding Keymapper to the remaining engines. Only about 45% of ScummVM-supported engines have this feature. The current list can be found on our Wiki. And the relevant task blog will eventually be hosted at Aun's GSoC blog
Malhar Badve (aka SuperLemon) is our Director contributor for this year. He has already added more improvements to QTVR, but our overall hope for this year is to add movie saving capability, which is required by many titles. You will be able to follow the progress for this task on Malhar’s GSoC blog.
Shivang Nagta will pick up work on a system for verifying game file integrity, validating their checksums against those present in a central database. It will also let users contribute the checksums of game files not on the database. You can follow the progress for this task on Shivang’s GSoC blog.
Alikhan Balpykov will help us with completing the qdEngine implementation this year. You can follow the progress for this task on Alikhan GSoC blog.
Please give them a warm welcome, and visit our Discord server if you want to discuss those projects. After a four week Community Bounding period, the coding period will start on June 2, and you can expect regular updates on these projects on their respective blogs. The team is very excited about the upcoming summer – and we hope you are as well.
>
articles.title: Google Summer of Code 2025 – Five Participants are Joining Us This Year

operations. An attacker in a guest could use this issue to perform insecure
file operations and possibly elevate privileges in the guest.

articles.description:
It was discovered that Rack incorrectly handled deleted rack sessions. An
attacker could possibly use this issue to expose sensitive information or
to gain unauthorized access to user accounts. (CVE-2025-32441)

It was discovered that Rack incorrectly limited the number of parameters
in a web request. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04
LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.10, and Ubuntu 25.04. (CVE-2025-46727)

articles.description:
It was discovered that Abseil incorrectly handled memory with the upper
bound of the size argument. An attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause a denial of service or memory corruption.
articles.title: USN-7505-1: Abseil vulnerability

articles.description:
Juraj Šarinay discovered that LibreOffice incorrectly handled verifying
PDF signatures. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
generate PDF files that appear to have a valid signature.
articles.title: USN-7504-1: LibreOffice vulnerability

articles.description:
Jeppe Bonde Weikop discovered that h11 incorrectly handled crafted HTTP
requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to smuggle
malicious HTTP requests, which could potentially lead to security
control bypass and information leakage.
articles.title: USN-7503-1: h11 vulnerability

articles.description:
USN-7501-1 fixed a vulnerability in Django. This update provides
the corresponding update for Ubuntu 18.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 Elias Myllymäki discovered that Django incorrectly handled stripping large
 sequences of incomplete HTML tags. A remote attacker could possibly use
 this issue to cause Django to consume resources, leading to a denial of
 service.
